name: Mèo Hàng Xóm
source:
An is a young office worker trying to balance her work with her hectic life. Her destiny seemed surrounded by cats she doesn't like. Until one night, when she wakes up and finds herself becoming one of them. Can An overcome the dangerous and mysterious life of the cats and find a way to return to being human?

[translated from [url=https://lion-yrish-game.itch.io/meo-hang-xom]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
安是一名年轻上班族，努力在工作与忙乱的生活之间取得平衡。她的命运，似乎总被自己不喜欢的猫围绕。直到某晚，她醒来后，发现自己也成了其中一员。安能克服猫咪生活中的危险与谜团，找到变回人类的方法吗？

[译自[url=https://lion-yrish-game.itch.io/meo-hang-xom]itch.io[/url]]
